title: Reading a fitted line
summary: Read numbers off a least-squares fit, then judge the model.
prompt: The plot shows nine points and the least-squares line through them. Read the numbers below off the figure; the crosshair reads the axes, and a click pins a reading.
hints: The slope is rise over run: pin the line at two x values far apart, such as 0 and 8.
explainBack: Is a straight line the right model for this data? Say what the residuals tell you.

questions.prompt: The residual at x = 0 (data minus line)
